en_title: Florence Pugh Wants to Be a Bond Villain In Denis Villeneuve's 007 Movie With Robert Pattinson
cn_title: 弗洛伦丝·皮尤希望在罗伯特·帕丁森主演、丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导的《007》电影中饰演邦德反派
opus_summary: 罗伯特·帕丁森获选饰演新一任詹姆斯·邦德后，弗洛伦丝·皮尤表示，她已立即发短信给导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦，询问是否有适合自己的反派角色。布拉德·皮特也表达了出演邦德反派的兴趣，并称赞了帕丁森的选角。

paragraphs.en: Florence Pugh has thrown her hat in the ring in the hopes of becoming the next Bond villain after news of Robert Pattinson’s casting took over social media yesterday.
paragraphs.cn: 罗伯特·帕丁森获选出演的消息昨日传遍社交媒体后，弗洛伦丝·皮尤也加入了竞争，希望成为下一位邦德反派。

paragraphs.en: Robert Pattinson is your new James Bond , as revealed in an official video clip on November 16 that subsequently went viral. His casting has sparked no end of debate among fans , with some welcoming him into the fold with open arms, while others are arguing that they’d much prefer the likes of Henry Cavill, instead (though it seems Cavill wasn’t in the final list of actors who tested for the role).
paragraphs.cn: 11月16日发布的一段官方视频揭晓，罗伯特·帕丁森将成为新任詹姆斯·邦德，这段视频随后迅速传播开来。他的选角在粉丝间引发了无休止的争论，有些人张开双臂欢迎他加入，也有人表示他们更希望看到亨利·卡维尔之类的演员出演（尽管卡维尔似乎并未进入最终试演该角色的演员名单）。

paragraphs.en: Now that we have our new Bond, fans are going wild, sharing their personal picks for a villain to play opposite him — and even some A-List actors are vying for the part. Florence Pugh is one such actor, who admitted that she’d immediately texted director Denis Villeneuve out of interest in the part.
paragraphs.cn: 如今新任邦德已经确定，粉丝们兴奋不已，纷纷分享自己心目中与他对戏的反派人选，甚至一些一线演员也在争取这个角色。弗洛伦丝·皮尤就是其中之一，她承认自己因为对这个角色感兴趣，立即给导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦发了短信。

paragraphs.en: "Congratulations on finding your Bond, nice catch. Any villains the size of a 5ft 4in female?" she said at Elle’s Women in Hollywood event, recounting the message she’d sent him.
paragraphs.cn: 她在Elle的Women in Hollywood活动上复述了自己发给他的短信：「恭喜你找到了邦德，选得不错。有没有身材和一名5英尺4英寸的女性差不多的反派？」

paragraphs.en: Pugh isn’t the only one gunning to be a Bond villain; Brad Pitt also expressed interest in the idea, telling Extra TV when approached with the topic, "You know what, I'd like to do that. I mean, my man Javier [Bardem] did it so well. It's tall shoes, but I'd take that on, yeah."
paragraphs.cn: 皮尤并不是唯一一个想出演邦德反派的人；布拉德·皮特也对此表达了兴趣，在Extra TV向他提起这个话题时说道：「你知道吗，我很想演。我的意思是，我的朋友哈维尔·巴登演得太好了。要接他的班很难，但我愿意接受挑战，没错。」

paragraphs.en: Pitt also had some kind words for Pattinson after learning of his casting, saying, “Is that right? You know what, I love this idea. I love what he's been doing. I love his choices, I think he's the real deal. That's great, good call."
paragraphs.cn: 皮特得知帕丁森获选出演后，也对他说了一些赞赏的话：「真的吗？你知道吗，我喜欢这个主意。我喜欢他一直以来的表现。我喜欢他的选择，我认为他确实有真本事。太好了，选得好。」

paragraphs.en: Even former Bond actor George Lazenby weighed in on the news , giving Pattinson some sage advice as someone who has already played the part and experienced all the opinions that came with it.
paragraphs.cn: 就连前邦德扮演者乔治·拉扎贝也对这一消息发表了看法。作为已经演过这个角色、经历过随之而来的各种评价的人，他给了帕丁森一些明智的建议。

paragraphs.en: “I hear they've announced the new James Bond,” Lazenby wrote in a post shared on social media. “Robert, welcome to the most exclusive club in the world. But remember to enjoy yourself. Let's see if you'll have [a] ‘This never happened to the other fella!’ moment. All the best, mate, George xx.”
paragraphs.cn: 拉扎贝在社交媒体上发布的一篇帖子中写道：「我听说他们已经宣布了新任詹姆斯·邦德。罗伯特，欢迎加入世界上最独一无二的俱乐部。但记得要玩得开心。让我们看看你会不会遇到『这种事在另一个家伙身上可从没发生过！』的时刻。祝一切顺利，伙计，乔治xx。」

paragraphs.en: Pattinson reportedly competed with Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor, and Nicholas Hoult for Bond, and was even given a far more lucrative deal for less films than other talent in the running. He auditioned for the role while filming for The Batman Part II was on pause — a project that now sits in limbo thanks to his latest gig.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，帕丁森与卡勒姆·特纳、杰克·劳登、乔什·奥康纳和尼古拉斯·霍尔特竞争邦德一角，他获得的片约甚至比其他竞争者优厚得多，要求出演的电影却更少。他是在《新蝙蝠侠2》暂停拍摄期间试演这个角色的，而由于他接下的这份最新工作，该项目如今陷入了不确定状态。

paragraphs.en: While we likely won’t be seeing anything from Pattinson’s Bond for some time, fans can whet their appetites with Dune: Part Three , which comes to theaters this December.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然我们可能还要过一段时间才能看到帕丁森版邦德的任何内容，但粉丝可以先看《沙丘3》解解馋，该片将于今年12月上映。
